propositions: BindingRepository must round-trip legacy and unknown-field fixtures to byte-identical sorted/indented JSON with trailing newlines and perform no eager writes on construction.
Save must attempt rotation persistence before live file replacement, even when no in-memory state change has occurred.
Corrupt live state raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired state fails open with best-effort alerting and preserves the file.

Rotation tempfile/write/replace failure leaves the sidecar unchanged, writes live file with new bytes retaining inline last_get_pass, and does not raise; the next successful save converges the sidecar from the retained inline floor.
Retired tempfile/write/replace failure leaves retired and live files unchanged, cleans temporary files, and raises an exception.

Live tempfile/write/replace failure leaves the live file unchanged, retains any earlier successful sidecar/retired writes, cleans temporary files, and raises an exception; alert persistence failure is swallowed without altering the successful state-file result.
